description: Registry of designated single-source artifacts. For each artifact, exactly one file is the canonical definition. Every other copy under prototype/handoff/visual-diffs paths must either byte-match the canonical sha256 OR textually import it (relative or @/-aliased). A divergent copy that neither matches nor imports = FAIL.
scope_comment: duplicate_search_globs list paths to scan for copies. Canonical path is excluded from scanning automatically.

artifacts.description: WorldlineGlobe React component — the Three.js globe rendered on the home page. Three divergent blobs exist across branches; this gate enforces convergence.
Soul-atom design token source (CSS custom properties). app/globals.css is the single source; any copied subset must be byte-identical where the tokens appear.
